chunks: Who had set up another god with God. Cast him into severe torment.
ai.seo_question: What happens to those who set up another god with Allah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Qaf underscores the gravity of shirk as the ultimate deviation, contrasting it with the monotheism (tawhid) emphasized by the Imams. The 'severe torment' is interpreted not merely as physical punishment but as the spiritual alienation from the Divine Presence, a theme frequently elaborated in tafsir works like Al-Mizan. This serves as a warning against internalizing polytheism through neglecting divine guidance.
